proposals.before: He Ning, whose courtesy name was Chengji, came from Xuchang in Yan Prefecture.
proposals.after: He Ning, whose courtesy name was Chengji, came from Xuchang in Yun Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 鄆州 is Yun Prefecture, not Yan Prefecture; the idiomatic English misreads 鄆.

proposals.before: He Ning, courtesy name Chengji, was a native of Xuchang in Yan Prefecture.
proposals.after: He Ning, courtesy name Chengji, was a native of Xuchang in Yun Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 鄆州 is Yun Prefecture, not Yan Prefecture; the literal English misreads 鄆.

proposals.before: When Gui returned, he admonished his sons: "Young He is a man who records righteousness in his heart; he is sure to become rich and noble hereafter—you must serve him carefully!"
proposals.after: When Gui returned, he admonished his sons: "Young He is a man of loyal resolve; he is sure to become rich and noble hereafter—you must serve him carefully!"
proposals.reason: 誌義/志義 means loyal resolve or righteous purpose, not "records righteousness in his heart."

proposals.before: During Taizu of Zhou's reign, when peace was made with the Khitan, Tian Min was sent as left vice director of the Ministry of Revenue on mission to Khitan. He encountered Ying at Youzhou, and Ying wept uncontrollably at the sight of him.
proposals.after: During Taizu of Zhou's reign, when peace was made with the Khitan, Tian Min was sent as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs on mission to Khitan. He encountered Ying at Youzhou, and Ying wept uncontrollably at the sight of him.
proposals.reason: 尚書左丞 is Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, not of the Ministry of Revenue.

proposals.before: During Zhou Taizu's time, when peace was made with Khitan, Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue Tian Min was sent on mission to Khitan. He encountered Ying at Youzhou; when Ying saw Min he was so grief-stricken he could not contain himself.
proposals.after: During Zhou Taizu's time, when peace was made with Khitan, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Tian Min was sent on mission to Khitan. He encountered Ying at Youzhou; when Ying saw Min he was so grief-stricken he could not contain himself.
proposals.reason: 尚書左丞 is Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, not of the Ministry of Revenue.

proposals.before: Lu Qi, whose courtesy name was Huishan, came from Anci in You Prefecture.
proposals.after: Lü Qi, whose courtesy name was Huishan, came from Anci in You Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 呂琦 should be romanized Lü Qi, not Lu Qi (which confuses 呂 with 盧).

proposals.before: Lu Qi, courtesy name Huishan, was a native of Anci in You Prefecture.
proposals.after: Lü Qi, courtesy name Huishan, was a native of Anci in You Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 呂琦 should be romanized Lü Qi, not Lu Qi (which confuses 呂 with 盧).

proposals.before: Lu Qi had a fine bearing and valued integrity. After losing his family while still young, he traveled to study in the Fen and Jin regions.
proposals.after: Lü Qi had a fine bearing and valued integrity. After losing his family while still young, he traveled to study in the Fen and Jin regions.
proposals.reason: 呂琦 should be Lü Qi not Lu Qi.

proposals.before: Gaozu moved to Yan, planning to hold Taiyuan and defy the throne. He summoned his staff to ask their view. Some in the room approved; others were too frightened to speak. Rong alone answered calmly: "I am only a Confucian scholar. I have never studied military affairs. How can one lightly pronounce on advance or retreat, on survival or ruin?"
proposals.after: Gaozu moved to Yun, planning to hold Taiyuan and defy the throne. He summoned his staff to ask their view. Some in the room approved; others were too frightened to speak. Rong alone answered calmly: "I am only a Confucian scholar. I have never studied military affairs. How can one lightly pronounce on advance or retreat, on survival or ruin?"
proposals.reason: 鄆 is Yun Prefecture, not Yan.

proposals.before: He was the great-grandson of Tang Left Vice Censor Qi Zhi.
proposals.after: He was the great-grandson of Tang Left Vice Director Wang Qi.
proposals.reason: 唐左僕射起 is Wang Qi (王起), Left Vice Director (僕射), not 'Left Vice Censor Qi Zhi'.

proposals.before: He was the great-grandson of Tang Left Vice Censor Qi Zhi.
proposals.after: He was the great-grandson of Tang Left Vice Director Qi.
proposals.reason: 唐左僕射起 refers to Wang Qi; 僕射 is Vice Director, not Vice Censor.
